subCategories.label: Money
playerOptions: Could you spare a few emeralds, {npc}?
I'm running low on coin. Can you help me out?

npcResponses: For you, {player}? Of course. Here, take these.
You've done plenty for {village}. It's the least I can do.
Emeralds don't grow on trees, {player}.
I work hard for my coin. Ask someone else.
You barely know me and you're already asking for money?
Hmm... I'll think about it. Come back later.
Maybe if you help me with something first.

subCategories.label: Political Favor
playerOptions: I need your support on something important for {village}.
As a leader, I could use your backing on a matter.

npcResponses: You have my support, {player}. What do you need?
For the good of {village}, I'll do what I can.
A leader who asks rather than demands earns my respect.
Political favors require trust, {player}. We're not there yet.
I don't make promises to people I barely know.
Earn your place in {village} first. Then we'll talk.
And what's in it for me, exactly?
Favors aren't free, {player}. What are you offering?

subCategories.label: Task
playerOptions: I have a job that needs doing. Interested?
Could you handle something for me, {npc}?

npcResponses: I'm listening. What do you need done?
Depends on the task. Tell me more, {player}.
If it helps {village}, count me in.
Ugh, more work? Can't someone else do it?
I'm already exhausted from doing... well, nothing. But still.

subCategories.label: Directions
playerOptions: Do you know where I can find anything interesting nearby?
Which way to the nearest point of interest?

npcResponses: Head past the old well and keep north. You'll find something.
I've heard there's something worth seeing east of {village}.
Talk to the cartographer if you want real directions. But I'd say head south.
Directions? Follow the clouds. They always know where to go.
I once walked in a circle for three days. Found my way eventually.
